digital-brain-neo4j.note: Local Neo4j Cypher MCP endpoint for avatar_digital_brain. Exposes read/write Cypher, server-owned JournalEntry append tools (get_journal_chain_head, append_journal_entry, get_journal_append_receipt), and typed quality sensors (get_quality_receipt, get/record_harness_generation, create_feedback, revoke_feedback, record_run_event). Sensors require harness_generation_id; model-facing record_run_event is always model_advisory; reconcile timeouts via get_quality_receipt (never blind-retry). Literal URL: some hosts do not expand shell-style env defaults in plugin MCP URLs.
